h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Deoghar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Deoghar

items.pText: Deoghar is best known for the Baidyanath temple, and much of the town's year runs around pilgrims. That shapes who asks us for playground equipment here: hotels and dharamshalas with a family courtyard, temple trusts with an open garden, and schools in the town and nearby blocks. FunPlay Systems makes all of this equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,530 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

A play area at a pilgrim hotel or trust garden sees short, heavy bursts of use. During the Shravan month the crowds swell, and dozens of children may use the same slide in one evening. For that kind of site we suggest compact pieces with few moving parts, such as a multi play system with slides and climbers on one frame. Send us a few photos and the size of your space, and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a play corner for a hotel or trust garden

c: Most hotel and dharamshala courtyards in Deoghar are paved, and stone or concrete is a hard surface for a fall. Lay rubber flooring under the equipment, which we can supply with the order. Keep the play corner away from the main entrance so parents can watch children without blocking the path. Summers here are very hot, so place slides and decks where a wall or tree gives shade in the afternoon.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on a paved courtyard in Deoghar?
items.a: Yes. On a firm paved base we usually use the self-standing method and add rubber flooring under the play zone. Where the ground is soft soil, we grout the posts instead.

items.q: Is the equipment suitable for heavy use during festival crowds?
items.a: Our frames are galvanised pipe and our plastic parts are roto-moulded, both covered by a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. For crowded sites we suggest fewer moving parts and a larger clear zone around each piece.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Deoghar?
items.a: We dispatch it from Vasai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India then sets it up, following the layout drawing you approved.
